“魏沐，你对MV女主角有什么想法？”

惠通时代广场三楼，某间会议室内，午后的阳光透过百叶窗斜斜地切进来，在深色会议桌上投下明暗相间的条纹。

老板宋柯和制作人张亚冬分坐两侧，目光都落在中间低头不语的魏沐身上。

见到他正在思考，一向大方的老宋轻点手中的香烟，开口：“《体面》是你的成名作，MV的男主肯定是你来演。至于女主角.....”

他顿了顿，露出一个“男人都懂的”表情。

“如果你想请哪位知名演员来搭档，尽管开口，公司可以帮你安排。”

这算是他给手下艺人的一个小福利。

年轻人嘛，谁没几个偶像。

有机会和偶像拍戏，即便是MV，也够过瘾！！

他年轻的时候喜欢张曼瑜，可惜张曼瑜那种级别的演员不可能演MV。

“你尽管说，我在影视圈有些朋友，可以帮忙介绍。”

作为魏沐首张专辑的负责人，张亚冬希望《体面》的MV大火。

魏沐闻言，微微侧过头，嘴角几不可察地动了一下。

我想请高媛媛过来拍，你愿意吗？

想是这样想，现实根本不可能，高媛媛年纪太大，不符合女主角人设。

他原本属意刘施施，气质干净，年龄合适。

最重要的是施施还没变成瞎姐，眼睛有神！！

可惜这姑娘被蔡艺侬叫回了魔都，正为《射雕英雄传》的宣传忙得不可开交。

而且对方不一定答应，《体面》是写给前女友的，她一个现女友过来演？

如果真这样做，刘施施可能认为自己在侮辱她，得不偿失。

“哎！！”

宋柯拍了拍桌子，猛地想起一个适合人选：“你觉得刘一菲怎么样？”

说完这句话，他又看向右侧：“亚东。你和刘一菲熟悉吗？”

张亚冬双手抱臂靠在椅背上，闻言直接摇头，语气平淡：“不熟悉。”

魏沐满脸诧异的看着宋柯。

老宋，你特么比我还敢想啊？

这个时间段刘一菲在干什么？人家在宣传《功夫之王》

《功夫之王》，男主角程龙李联杰.....

你让她过来演MV女主角？

先不说她会不会答应，都过不了她老妈那一关。

“刘一菲算了，我对她没什么兴趣。”

魏沐摆了摆手，随手给老板一个台阶下。

他心知肚明，要是宋柯真的派人去邀请，结局只会有一个。

"Wei Mu, what do you think of the MV heroine?"

In a conference room on the third floor of Huitong Times Square, the afternoon sunlight slanted in through the blinds, casting alternating light and dark stripes on the dark conference table.

Boss Song Ke and producer Zhang Yadong sat on opposite sides, their eyes falling on Wei Mu who bowed his head and remained silent in the middle.

Seeing that he was thinking, Lao Song, who was always generous, lighted the cigarette in his hand and said: ""Decent" is your famous work, and you will definitely play the male lead in the MV. As for the female lead..."

He paused and showed an expression that "every man knows".

"If you want to ask a well-known actor to co-star, just ask and the company can help you arrange it."

This is a small benefit he gives to his artists.

Young people don’t have many idols.

Having the opportunity to film with an idol, even if it is a MV, is quite enjoyable!!

When he was young, he liked Zhang Manyu, but unfortunately it was impossible for an actor of Zhang Manyu's level to act in a music video.

"Just tell me, I have some friends in the film and television industry who can help introduce them."

As the person in charge of Wei Mu's first album, Zhang Yadong hopes that the MV for "Decent" will become a hit.

When Wei Mu heard this, he turned his head slightly and the corners of his mouth moved almost imperceptibly.

I would like to invite Gao Yuanyuan to come over and take pictures. Are you willing?

If you think so, it is simply impossible in reality. Gao Yuanyuan is too old and does not fit the heroine's character.

He originally preferred Liu Shishi, who had a clean temperament and was of the right age.

The most important thing is that Shi Shi hasn't turned into a blind girl yet, her eyes are bright!!

It's a pity that this girl was called back to the Magic City by Cai Yinong, and she was very busy with the promotion of "The Legend of the Condor Heroes".

And the other party may not necessarily agree. "Decent" was written for an ex-girlfriend, and her current girlfriend came to act in it?

If you do this, Liu Shishi may think that you are insulting her and the loss outweighs the gain.

"Hey!!"

Song Ke patted the table and suddenly remembered a suitable candidate: "What do you think of Liu Yifei?"

After saying this, he looked to the right: "Yadong. Are you familiar with Liu Yifei?"

Zhang Yadong folded his arms and leaned on the back of the chair. He shook his head and said in a calm tone: "I'm not familiar with it."

Wei Mu looked at Song Ke with surprise.

Old Song, how dare you think more than me?

What is Liu Yifei doing during this time?People are promoting "The King of Kung Fu"

"The King of Kung Fu", the male protagonist Cheng Long and Jet Li...

You asked her to come over and play the heroine in the MV?

Not to mention whether she would agree or not, she still wouldn't be able to pass her mother's test.

"Forget it Liu Yifei, I have no interest in her."

Wei Mu waved his hand and gave the boss a step down.

He knew very well that if Song Ke really sent someone to invite him, there would only be one ending.
